geometry: A single white horizontal double-headed arrow with straight diagonal arrowheads and a 4-unit-high central shaft. The 20 by 20 source has visible ink approximately from x=1 to 19 and y=5 to 15; the vector uses those same nominal extents.
limitations: The smooth diagonal edges render with antialiasing rather than the source PNG's pixel-stepped edges. The SVG was rendered at native size and 8x, and the enlarged rendering was visually inspected.
